overview: Chroma is an open-source vector database for AI applications, providing storage, indexing, and search over embeddings through a simple API.
description:
Chroma is an open-source search infrastructure for AI. It stores embeddings together with their documents and metadata, and provides vector, full-text, and metadata search through Python, JavaScript, and Rust clients.

This package deploys the official chromadb/chroma server as a single container. Data is persisted in a named volume mounted at /data, and the HTTP API is published on port 8000. No custom configuration is required for a default single-node deployment.

Typical use cases include retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), semantic search, recommendation systems, and any application that needs to store and query embeddings.
